notes.title: Woven Patch 1.1 & Deluxe Edition Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789986/b8b81da1ce10ee1a63997d55917df9df7dd465a8.jpg[/img]
March is a special month for the StickyLock and Alterego Games teams. This is the month we’re bringing out our new game. But we haven’t forgotten about Woven! This month we release the Woven 1.1 patch and with it the original soundtrack composed by Vortigon. 
To underline the festivities, we’re holding a mega super sale of 90%. If you don’t have Woven yet, without a doubt this is the best moment get it and dive into the woollen world of woven and find out why it is being attacked by metal steam driven spiders.

[b]Woven Patch 1.1 release notes:[/b]
- Reversed Y-axis Support!
- Added stability and memory optimalisation.
- Fixed German subtitle errors.
- Fixed Dutch subtitle errors.

[b]The Woven OST:[/b]
A whopping hour and a half worth of soundtracks, uniquely remastered to translate the games soundtrack in a smooth music album perfect for all easy-listening enthusiasts.

[b]Interested in our new title? [/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275660/Sanity_of_Morris/][h1]Sanity of Morris[/h1][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789986/c7347873146a689c5a4bbbd446df2e708639161a.gif[/img]
It isn’t even half as cute as Woven, but an adventure game with a mystery twist just as well. Not everything is what it seems in this psychological horror game. 
In Sanity of morris you use your flashlight to reveal the vital clues you need to find your father. The game combines elements of stealth games with detective-adventure and psychological horror for a gripping story. Discover the truth! Could aliens be real?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789986/4c11c0297ead6cd8c37c71b0edd165324b3b36f6.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275660

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789986/a49134b3e279e0ebafd2068e652b8f8be2a1cd3e.png[/img]
We are proud to tell you that for the majority of the world and platforms, Woven is out now on Steam, Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Switch.

notes.title: Woven Release Date announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Great News![/h1]
The release date of Woven has been made public! We will release our game the 15th of November this year, one month from now. 
Woven will release on Steam (macOs, Windows, Linux) but also on Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch.  And yes, this the confirmation of a day one Linux release. 
We’ve created a new trailer to show glimpses of all Woven has to offer in terms of scenery, action and gameplay.

Check it out [url=https://youtu.be/qf0E4dNymWQ]here[/url]!

[h1]About Woven:[/h1]
We envisioned Woven as being the ultimate chill-out-on-the-couch adventure game with laidback gameplay supported by a great soundtrack, colourful look and super cute creatures. 
In Woven you’ll go out to adventure and explore a world made of fabric, where stuffed animals once lived in peace. Everything in Woven appears to be well at first glance, but be warned, the colourful world is not all it seems to be. 

Stuffy, a cute but clumsy elephant, wanders the lands all by himself. Glitch, a metal firefly, has no memory of this world, and the mystery of his arrival holds the key to the heart of the matter.
In the game you will search for hidden objects and secrets and customize Stuffy with different animal shapes to gain new abilities that help you solve puzzles. It is an epic adventure with two very unlikely heroes and a story narrated in rhyme.
Why is this land being invaded by metal machines?
Explore a woollen world and unravel its mysteries the 15th of November.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/FSxvQMh]Discord[/url] and ask us anything!

notes.title: Update on Woven Gameplay
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/ac09a1512928adf13d432aa75766bfb8dad59291.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

It’s been a while since the pre-alpha demo and some parts of the games have been changed quite a lot. So we want to update you on some of the things that have changed. The big picture is still the same;  explore a woollen world, find collect lots of colours and fabrics, and find new shapes for Stuffy while you enjoy the story in rhyme.

But we’ve also added lots of new stuff, and changed some things around.  So here is a quick update on some of the gameplay features that have a prominent role in the game, WITH some brand-new screenshots and artwork!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/5757c967ce65dedc4ffc6a622cff62efaada21ed.jpg[/img]

[h1]Blueprint Machines[/h1]

Stuffy will change during the game, as you can swap out body part of different shape and form. Elephant legs are strong, but rabbit legs can jump! Previously, you could encounter creatures just like Stuffy, scan them, and then Glitch would make a blueprint for you. Well this has changed!

There are many new animal shapes in Woven, but the only way to get a new shape is by finding and unlocking a blueprint machine. This will require a sharp eye and a bit of timing! 

As in the demo, each animal-shape will have their own skillset, so keep an eye out for these machines, as they will give you more customisation options.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/42587fdc389b1daa845ac7d22702ff89374ccde8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hidden Dangers[/h1]

You'd be surprised how many hidden dangers a 'safe' woollen world can harbour! Those of you that have played the demo know the gameplay is not all softness and wool. There are metal machines about. Spotting, recognizing and getting past these dangers is a very important part of the game. Sometimes it comes down to being quick, at other times you’ll have to be creative.

Creating these dangers has been a real design challenge. We didn’t want to bog down Wovens relaxed play-style with frightening jumpscares; that’s not the game we want to make! But we did want certain areas in the game where Stuffy would have to walk on his proverbial toes. We think you’ll like what we’ve cooked up.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/ddff87032ec752bda48acc2140abc47459e599d5.png[/img]


[h1]Secret Caves[/h1]

New and important, hidden caves are scattered all over the world. They will be difficult to find, but will reward you with beautiful hand-drawn cave drawings that tell a whole story of their own. Finding theses caves isn’t necessary to complete the game, but will certainly add to your knowledge of the Woven word in a way you might not have expected.

That’s it for this update. Questions about the gameplay? Feeling the hype yet? Don’t hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/FSxvQMh]Discord channel[/url] and flood us with your questions or just random talks.

Alterego Team out!

notes.title: Woven found a publisher: StickyLock Studios
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/c49e519710b2dc4a82df66df05e131b978b63986.jpg[/img]

[h1]Woven, it is happening![/h1]
Woven: The unique adventure game where a seemingly safe woollen world is actually being threatened by metal insects. (shush, spoilers!). The game that lets you puzzle and explore your way through a rhyming story by changing the body parts of your hopelessly clumsy main character. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/cf49a78414918f02396ebee3444b0ed4524e24e8.png[/img]
 
[h1]The time is now[/h1]
Ever since the Kickstarter in 2016 the Alterego Games Team has been developing Woven at a slow but steady pace.
Slow and steady usually wins the race usually, but this was taking too long.  At the start of 2019 the studio made the decision that if they wanted to develop Woven, this would the year to do it, making it the studios main focus. 
With their own funds, spare time and lots of effort the studio’s small team developed the game up to the halfway mark, and then set out to find a publisher.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/bd0a8706e7a54f1cf500f56519e40d9e8f71f6de.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Publisher found.[/h1]
We found them, or better, they found us. 
StickyLock Studios, a Dutch publisher with lots of tech and game experience will help publish the game while bestowing full creative freedom to the Alterego team. 
Together we want to bring something unique to the gaming world. Combining the quirkiness of an stubborn indie-developer with the experience of an established publisher and multiplatform launch!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/80bb87a5c5289d56c8ace48fe6ee8c6d9e1d9dec.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]And now? [/h1]
All the actual game levels are now in place, recordings for game narration have begun, puzzles and content are being developed every day, while also working on cinematic cameras shots to augment both ambiance and storytelling. 

While making the best game we can is our main focus, we’ll also try to regularly show what we’re creating. We’ll be opening a [url=https://discord.gg/FSxvQMh]Discord channel[/url], (come join us!) and show content through Facebook, Instagram and Twitter, with the odd newsletter in between.  

With the launch of our trailer soon, we’ll also be able to make some pretty mind-boggling news about all our plans for Woven. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789986/1852d60d1db93170f823c72b1a9a8cd52ba5ac52.jpg[/img]

 
Alterego Team out.
